questions_and_answers.question: How can the past participle in an extended adjective construction be translated?

answers.answer: As a passive or with the noun as the object

questions_and_answers.question: Which report describes the naming of Sir Robert Vansittart to Chief Diplomatic Adviser?

answers.answer: A report from the German Embassy in London

questions_and_answers.question: In the Rome telegram, who sent the message?
What instruction is given in the Rome telegram regarding rumors of mediation in the Far East conflict?

answers.answer: Describe the rumors as completely unfounded

questions_and_answers.question: Which government desired the supplementary protocol mentioned in the Moscow telegram?

answers.answer: The Government of the Soviet Union

questions_and_answers.question: What does the term ‘citissime’ indicate in the telegram heading?
In the London report, what effect did the naming of Sir Robert Vansittart have?

answers.answer: It aroused general notice among the local public

questions_and_answers.question: How is the telegram addressed to the German Embassy in Rome classified?
Who is the author of the telegram to the Embassy in Moscow?
Which of the following words from the vocabulary list means ‘to negotiate’?

articles.text:
Part C introduces the past participle within extended adjective constructions and explains that the past participle can be translated as a passive or with the noun functioning as the object of the participle.

Example 1 vocabulary:
Dieses Monats (of this month)
Gemeldet (reported)
Die Ernennung,-en (naming)
Hiesig (local)
Die Öffentlichkeit (public)
Das Aufsehen (notice)
Erregen (to arouse)
Im Auftrag (in behalf of)

Sentence and report:
Die Deutsche Botschaft in London an das Auswärtige Amt. London, den 5. Januar 1938. A.A. eing. 6. Januar 1938 Nm. (pol II 51). Die bereits mit Bericht vom 1. d.M. gemeldete Ernennung von Sir Robert Vansittart zum Chief Diplomatie Adviser hat in der hiesigen Öffentlichkeit allgemeines Aufsehen erregt … Im Auftrag. E.v. Selzam.

Translation:
The German Embassy in London to the Foreign Office. London, January 5, 1938. Arrived Foreign Office January 6, 1938 PM (pol II 51). The naming of Sir Robert Vansittart to Chief Diplomatic Adviser, which was already announced in the report of the first of this month, has aroused general notice among the local public … In behalf (of the Ambassador). E.v. Selzam.

Example 2 vocabulary:
Der Staatssekretär,-e (Secretary of State)
Der Behördenleiter,- (Chief of Mission)
Die Verschlussache (Classified)
Entziffern (to decode)
Das Gerücht,-e (rumor)
Die Vermittlungsaktion,-en (mediation action)
Der Fernost‑Konflikt (Far East conflict)
Ansprechen (to speak to)
Unbegründet (unfounded)
Bezeichnen (to describe)

Telegram excerpt:
Staatssekretär von Mackensen an die Deutsche Botschaft in Rom. Telegramm. Strengst geheim. Nr. 352 vom 6. November 1937. Berlin, ab 6. November 1937. Rom, an 6. November 1937. Botsch. an 6. November 1937. 20:41 Uhr – 20:45 Uhr – 23:00 Uhr. Für Behördenleiter oder dessen Vertreter persönlich. Verschlussache. Selbst zu entziffern. Wenn Sie auf auch durch die Presse gegangenen Gerüchte wegen Deutscher Vermittlungsaktion im Fernost‑Konflikt angesprochen werden, bitte ich Sie, Gerüchte als ganz unbegründet zu bezeichnen. Mackensen.

Translation:
Secretary of State von Mackensen to the German Embassy in Rome. Telegram. Most secret. No. 352 of November 6, 1937. Berlin, sent November 6, 1937. Rome, arrived November 6, 1937. Ambassador, arrived November 6, 1937. 8:41 PM – 8:45 PM – 11:00 PM. For the Chief of Mission or his representative personally. Classified. To be decoded in person. If you are spoken to regarding rumors of German mediation action in the Far East conflict, which also were circulated by the press, I request you to describe the rumors as completely unfounded. Mackensen.

Example 3 vocabulary:
Der Reichsaussenminister,- (Foreign Minister)
Das Telegramm,-e (telegram)
Citissime (most urgent)
Die Ankunft (arrival)
Das Zusatz‑Protokoll (supplementary protocol)
Die Überzeugung (opinion)
Substantiell (substantial)
Klären (to clarify)
Verantwortlich (responsible)
Der Staatsmann (statesman)
Verhandeln (to negotiate)

Telegram and translation:
Der Reichsaussenminister an die Botschaft Moskau. Telegramm. Citissime. Nr. 189 vom 20. August. Berlin, den 20. August 1939. Ankunft: 21. August. 4:35 Uhr – 0:45 Uhr. Für den Herrn Botschafter persönlich. Das von der Regierung der Sowjetunion gewünschte Zusatz‑Protokoll kann nach meiner Überzeugung in kürzester Zeit substantiell geklärt werden, wenn ein verantwortlicher deutscher Staatsmann in Moskau hierüber selbst verhandeln kann … Ribbentrop.

Translation:
The Foreign Minister to the Embassy, Moscow. Telegram. Most urgent. No. 189 of Aug 20. For the Ambassador personally. Berlin, August 20, arrived August 21, 1939. 4:35 PM – 12:45 AM. The supplementary protocol desired by the Government of the Soviet Union can be clarified substantially in the shortest time, in my opinion, if a responsible German statesman in Moscow can negotiate this himself. – Ribbentrop.
